name: MicroDuck Courier
description: Pick, carry, and place a duck-scale paperback in a simulated MicroDuck apartment.
details: Custom Mjlab-Courier-Flat-MicroDuck task with an apartment scene, book, seated reader, and one deployable ONNX export. The publisher reports 16/16 and 32/32 successful simulated delivery rollouts. The task-specific command slots carry book and reader targets; no physical robot deployment is claimed.

verification.summary: Publisher-reported successful simulated courier rollouts; no physical hardware evidence reported.
verification.notes: The source repository has a vendored Apache-2.0 microduck_rl component but no separate top-level artifact license. Its custom apartment scene is outside the registry's current generic simulation verifier; registry simulation verification has not been run.

contract.actuator_model: Dynamixel XL330 (BAM M6 voltage control law)
